Vs
Haji Najir Ahmed and others ----- Pre-emptee-Opposite Parties
full_judgment: The land which has been transferred by virtue of kabala Ext. 8(ka) dt. 10-8-87 is partial subject matter of pre-emption case No. 53/87 filed on 16-11-87. So, the pre-emption to the extent of 61-1/3 decimal of land out of plot No. 3438 of Khatian No. 902 which has been sold by virtue of kabala Ext. 8(ka) cannot be considered as time barred since it is well and within the period of 4 months from the date of registration of the same. In this respect I find it needless to discuss the evidence on record because being an admitted co-sharer petitioner appellant is entitled to get the land by way of pre-emption which has been transferred by virtue of kabala Ext. 8(ka) to a stranger purchaser like opposite party No.1".
